name: Keln
source:
"The other person is unconventional in many ways. Let's find a steady way little by little without being impatient."

A young man who got lost in the game like Meguru.

He is always refreshing and soft, but he is an advanced player who has outstanding ability in the game.

[Translated from [url=https://blulunetta.web.fc2.com/pistole/story.html#keln]official website[/url]]
